case_title: Raju @ Balachandran & Ors. v. State of Tamil Nadu
aggravating_circumstances: Enmity between the accused and the victim
neutral_facts: The accused, three individuals, were involved in a homicidal attack on the brother and mother of PW5. The brother of PW5 was killed instantly during the attack, while his mother was grievously injured and later died. PW5, who was present at the scene, testified that the accused used a sickle to attack the victims. The police recovered the sickles used in the attack and the clothes worn by the accused. The trial court and high court accepted PW5's testimony as credible, despite his relationship to the victims, and convicted the accused for the murders. The evidence included eyewitness accounts, medical reports, and recovered items, confirming the occurrence of the attack and the injuries sustained by the victims.
